title: New Application Server Cannot Reach the Database
symptoms: A newly deployed application server cannot connect to the database server
The database server is reachable from other application servers
The switch port connecting the new server is up and passing traffic
The router between the two subnets shows an ACL applied inbound on the server VLAN
rootCause: The inbound ACL on the server VLAN does not have a permit statement for the new application server's IP. The implicit deny at the end of the ACL drops the traffic.

steps.prompt: Which command shows ACL hit counts to confirm which entries are matching traffic?
steps.hint: If you see the traffic hitting a 'deny' entry, the ACL is your problem.

steps.prompt: Which command shows which ACL is applied to which interface and in which direction?
steps.hint: Look for the 'Inbound access list' and 'Outbound access list' fields.

steps.prompt: Which command reveals the full ACL definition to check for the missing permit?
steps.hint: Verify the wildcard masks and the order of entries - ACLs are processed top-down.
